t: You're at Mecklenburgh Square, a Grade II listed square in the King's Cross area of Camden. It was part of the Foundling Estate, built between 1792 and 1825 on fields owned by the Foundling Hospital. The square is named after Queen Charlotte of Mecklenburg-Strelitz, wife of George III. It was begun in 1804 and finished in 1825. Two painter sisters were born here: Mary Hayllar, born 1862, and Kate Hayllar, born 1864. Both exhibited at the Royal Academy, and Kate is best remembered for her detailed flower and still life paintings.
